subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - KiteBank
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: John Patel <john.patel@kitebank.com>, Aisha Khan <aisha.k@kitebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - KiteBank

Hi John / Aisha,

Thanks again for your time today - great discussion and appreciate the transparency on latency targets and data controls. Quick recap and an initial proposed POC to help KiteBank validate Redwood across your main evaluation axes.

Demo highlights (from our call):
- End-to-end demo of the Redwood API: streaming responses, function calling, and embeddings for search.
- Observability: per-route latency and token-level cost breakdowns in the Console.
- Security: VPC-private deployment options + audit logs for Private deployments.

Proposed POC goals (high level):
1) Latency: 95th percentile tail under 300ms for your 512-token workflows in us-east-1.
2) Cost: Demonstrate ~30% token cost reduction vs current baseline through batching + caching.
3) Quality: Maintain or improve task-level accuracy on the 3 evaluation prompts you showed today.

Attached is a 1-page POC plan and an evaluation metrics spreadsheet with suggested success criteria and ownership. Key items in the plan:
- Scope: two main routes (Customer Support triage, Knowledge-base search + summarization).
- Duration: 4-week hands-on POC (2 weeks setup & integration, 2 weeks evaluation).
- Customer responsibilities: provide sample traffic and evaluation set, designate a technical owner and Product owner.
- Redwood responsibilities: private test environment, baseline benchmarking, weekly syncs, and a final recap.

Next steps (proposed):
1) You confirm success criteria and owner names (this week).
2) We kickoff a short onboarding call next Tue (30-45m) and share access details.
3) Redwood delivers baseline benchmarks within 5 business days of data/access.

Attachments: [Attachment: KiteBank-POC-Plan-v1.pdf (PDF, 120KB)], [Attachment: KiteBank-eval-metrics.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]

If that aligns, I can update the plan based on any edits and send a calendar invite for the kickoff.

Thanks,

Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dylan@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
From: John Patel <john.patel@kitebank.com>

Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - KiteBank

Thanks Dylan - good summary and appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifying questions before we lock the plan:

1) Success criteria: the latency target looks reasonable for the triage route but for search+summarization we'd want to be <400ms p95. Can we set route-specific targets in the plan?
2) Data: for the private test environment, does Redwood need full DB access or can we provide a sanitized export + sample traffic replay?
3) Ownership: Aisha will be the Engineering lead on our side; I'll be Executive sponsor. I'll loop in our infra/security lead if we need to discuss network/KMS.

Also can you add a short rollback/failure plan in case we see quality regressions during the POC? We need to be comfortable with fail-fast and easy rollback.

Happy to proceed - next step for us is confirming data access approach and owners. Can you also add expected engineer-hours for the setup?

John - thanks for the quick feedback and helpful questions. I updated the plan and metrics sheet to reflect route-specific latency targets and added a short rollback/failure play. Summary of updates below and next steps.

Updated success criteria (route-specific):
- Triage route: p95 <= 300ms (512 tokens)
- Search + summarization: p95 <= 400ms (typical 256-512 tokens)
- Cost: >= 25% token-cost reduction vs baseline (we set conservative 25% to start)
- Quality: no more than 5% relative degradation on your labeled eval set; any regression >5% triggers immediate rollback.

Data/access model:
- Preferred: sanitized export + sample traffic replay (no need for direct DB access).
- Optional: VPC peering for Private deployment sandbox (we can detail network steps if you prefer).

Setup effort estimate:
- Redwood engineering: ~2-3 days to spin up test environment and baseline runs; additional 1-2 days for tuning/quantization profiles.
- KiteBank engineering: ~1-2 days to prepare sanitized export and a point-of-contact for replay.

Rollback / failure plan (short):
- If quality regression >5% or stability issues arise, Redwood will revert to the agreed baseline configuration (same model + no quantization) and pause updates.
- We'll keep detailed logs and tracings available in Console for root cause analysis.

Attachments (updated): [Attachment: KiteBank-POC-Plan-v1.pdf (updated, PDF, 130KB)], [Attachment: KiteBank-eval-metrics.xlsx (updated, XLSX, 52KB)]

Proposed next steps (we can execute once you confirm):
1) You confirm owners and data approach (this week).
2) I'll send a calendar invite for a kickoff next Tue 10-10:30am ET (30m).
3) Redwood will deliver baseline benchmarks within 5 business days after access.

If Aisha is good with the plan I'll mark the kickoff and loop Marissa (our CS lead) for weekly check-ins.

Thanks - Dylan
